title: Smoked Salmon Sushi
description: A Japanese-inspired sushi recipe featuring smoked salmon, perfect for a delicious and easy-to-make meal.

ingredients.name: sushi vinegar
ingredients.notes: mixed with rice vinegar and sugar

instructions: Prepare the sushi vinegar by mixing rice vinegar and sugar. Set aside.
Cook the Japanese rice according to package instructions. Allow it to cool.
Cut the smoked salmon into small pieces and set aside.
Cut the cucumber and avocado into thin slices.
Prepare the pickled ginger by slicing it thinly.
To assemble the sushi, place a small amount of rice onto a sushi mat.
Add a few pieces of smoked salmon, cucumber, and avocado on top of the rice.
Roll the sushi using the sushi mat and slice into individual pieces.
Brush the sesame seeds with sesame oil and toast in the oven at 350°F.
Garnish the sushi with toasted sesame seeds and pickled ginger.
